friendly_name: Review context carries the WP diff and cited requirement text
purpose_context: Reviewers today get empty or Mission-wide REVIEW COMMANDS on single_branch and only bare requirement IDs, so they spend ~100 git commands hunting the implementation commit and ~100 reads of spec.md. This Mission computes each work package's review range from its recorded window and inlines a bounded diff plus the cited requirement text (issue #7578).
purpose_tldr: The review prompt shows each work package's own diff and the text of the requirements it cites.
